instrument: Arrêté du 22 décembre 2020 modifiant l'arrêté du 24 mai 2013 (plafonds de ressources ANAH)
content: Rebasing of 'très modestes' and 'modestes' base ceilings (e.g. 1 person outside IdF: 14,508 -> 14,879 very modest; 18,598 -> 19,074 modest; about +2.6%). These are the blue/yellow MPR ceilings.
ne_note: Looks like routine CPI updating, not a policy shift. Yearly values come from ANAH.

applies_to: ANAH subsidy applications from 2023-11-30; MPR from 2024-01-01 via arrêté 29 déc. 2023
instrument: Arrêté du 22 novembre 2023 modifiant l'arrêté du 24 mai 2013 (plafonds de ressources ANAH)
content: Labels 'très modestes', 'modestes' and new 'intermédiaires' ceilings inside the ANAH arrêté (before: MPR intermediate ceilings set in the MPR arrêté annex). Base tables rebased (1 person outside IdF: 16,229 very modest; 20,805 modest; 29,148 intermediate; about +9% vs 2021 base). Indexation rule rewritten: revised by ANAH each 1 Jan with CPI ex-tobacco, September n-2 to n-1 (was November to November).
ne_note: Unifies MPR and ANAH income brackets from 2024. Check whether the violet ceiling level moved vs the 2021-2023 MPR annex (not compared yet).

instrument: Décret 2024-249 + Arrêté 21 mars 2024 (ANAH news 'MaPrimeRénov' : les textes réglementaires sont publiés', 23/03/2024)
content: ANAH summary of the 'simplification' texts. Parcours accompagné unchanged. Par geste until 31 Dec (2024): available whatever the dwelling's DPE label; DPE no longer required from 15 May; insulation geste alone allowed from 15 May; ventilation only together with insulation; sale agreement accepted instead of title deed where needed. Applies to files submitted from 15 May 2024.
status: verified (ANAH page + Légifrance); already in main table
ne_note: Same event as the 2024-05-15 row of mpr_changes_2020_2025.csv. ANAH framing confirms the on/off of insulation-only par geste (barred 1 Jan-14 May 2024).

date_effect: unknown (announced as 'sur le point d'être lancée'; 3-year duration)
applies_to: small copropriétés (<20 housing lots) in town/village centres; collectivities with OPAH-RU, OPAH-CD or POPAC
instrument: ANAH experiment - MaPrimeRénov' Copropriété for small copropriétés (ANAH news 02/05/2024)
content: Experimental criteria for small copropriétés: share of main-residence lots lowered 75% -> 65%; 35% energy-gain threshold dropped in exchange for a global technical diagnostic (or energy audit) and a maître d'oeuvre with architectural and thermal skills; all works prescribed in the diagnostic must be done. Aid amounts unchanged. Interested: Rennes, Bayonne, Saint-Denis, Lille, Grenoble, Lyon; pending: Annonay, Sète, Agde, Le Havre, Bastia, Saumur, Brest, Béziers. Other collectivities can join by launching a POPAC.
status: announced; legal basis (likely ANAH board délibération) and start date not found
ne_note: Geographically targeted pilot (participating collectivities vs others, <20 lots vs larger): potential DiD for copro renovation. Need list of participating territories, start date and délibération.

instrument: ANAH instruction on MaPrimeRénov' Copropriétés and Habiter Mieux (ANAH legal publication 02/07/2021; circulaire HM du 30/06/2021, correctif 05/07)
content: Creation of MaPrimeRénov' Copropriétés. Habiter Mieux (Sérénité, predecessor of MPR Sérénité / parcours accompagné): minimum energy gain raised 25% -> 35%; works ceiling raised to 30 k€ (previous ceiling not stated on page; 20 k€ HT from memory, unverified). Rates, bonuses and effective date are in the two PDFs (one >10 MB, one unreadable here).
status: announced (ANAH page); details and dates not verified
ne_note: Tighter eligibility (35% gain) combined with higher ceiling: changes selection into global renovation for low-income owners. Need effective date (filing vs decision) from the circulaire.

instrument: ANAH board decision, referenced in press release 06/09/2023 (instrument not cited)
content: Works ceiling for MPR Sérénité raised 30,000 -> 35,000 € HT in January 2023 (stated in passing in the Sept. 2023 release).
status: announced (ANAH press release); legal basis not found
ne_note: Ceiling change only binds for large projects; exact date and instrument still to find.

applies_to: MPR Sérénité global renovations (very modest / modest owner-occupiers)
instrument: ANAH board decision of 06/09/2023 (press release; délibération number not cited)
content: Financing rate raised: very modest 50% -> 65%, modest 35% -> 50% of works (ceiling 35,000 € HT). ANAH puts the average aid increase at about 4,300 € (average subsidy about 18,600 € very modest, 14,500 € modest). Not clear whether 'from 1 Oct' means filing or decision date.
status: announced (ANAH press release); délibération not retrieved
ne_note: Sharp rate increase (+15 pts) for two income groups, three months before the 2024 reform: candidate for a before/after or bunching study on filing dates around 2023-10-01; overlaps with ceilings rebasing of 2023-11-30 and 2024 reform.

applies_to: ANAH aids (aides à la pierre) incl. MPR rénovation d'ampleur; new applications
instrument: Décret 2025-249 du 19 mars 2025 relatif aux aides de l'ANAH (art. R. 321-13 CCH)
content: Ends the non-cumulation of ANAH aid with the PTZ accession loan (L. 31-10-1 CCH): households that bought their main residence with a PTZ can now get ANAH aid / MPR rénovation d'ampleur. In force the day after JO, for new applications.
ne_note: Recent PTZ buyers become eligible from 2025-03-21: clear eligibility discontinuity by PTZ status (DiD vs non-PTZ recent buyers), if PTZ status is observable.

instrument: Décret 2025-249 (art. R. 321-17 CCH) + Arrêté du 28 mai 2025 modifying the règlement général de l'ANAH (arrêté 22 mai 2023)
content: Écrêtement: total public funding cap above which ANAH aid is clipped raised 80% -> 90% of operation cost TTC for 'modestes' (very modest already had a higher cap). Distinct from Décret 2024-819 (MPR minimum household share, main table 2025-01-01).
status: verified (Légifrance API); effective date of arrêté inferred
ne_note: Only binds for modest households cumulating local aids above 80%: affects reste à charge for heavily co-financed projects (territories with generous local top-ups). Interaction with the MPR-specific écrêtement in décret 2020-26 to be checked.
